estate.source: Cloudflare account zone inventory + Web Analytics site inventory

globaldeetsTraffic.note: Raw edge visits are materially contaminated by operational health traffic and must not be presented as human audience traction.

investmentThesis.label: Product
investmentThesis.title: A governed world-information layer is already live
investmentThesis.statement: GlobalDeets is operating as a source-first world desk with live news, place context, public knowledge, webcams, and an evidence-governance layer rather than a static portfolio demo.
investmentThesis.proof: Current product surfaces + governed source registry + Coverage & Evidence Observatory.

investmentThesis.label: Platform
investmentThesis.title: The wider estate creates distribution and data leverage
investmentThesis.statement: Twenty-five active web properties create a meaningful experimentation and distribution surface, while Culture Sherpa is a particularly relevant future context layer for GlobalDeets.
investmentThesis.proof: Cloudflare zone inventory; 21 of 25 properties already have browser observability.

investmentThesis.label: Execution
investmentThesis.title: The diagnostic system exposes uncertainty instead of hiding it
investmentThesis.statement: Mission Control separates operational traffic from certified audience, ranks unresolved gaps, and keeps business-critical measurement debt visible until evidence closes it.
investmentThesis.proof: Fail-closed Mission Control contract + explicit prioritized gap queue.

gaps.title: Certify human audience metrics
gaps.observed: Raw edge visits include substantial synthetic health traffic.
gaps.businessReason: Until human activity is separated from monitors, bots, APIs, and assets, traction cannot be responsibly shown to investors.
gaps.target: Human/bot/monitor/API/asset traffic classified before investor display
gaps.nextAction: Automate RUM and GA4 ingestion; publish certified human page-load, visitor, engagement, and referral metrics with explicit exclusions.
gaps.evidence: 36,391 raw edge visits; 31,681 attached to /_stcore/health in the current 28-day snapshot.

gaps.title: Close estate browser-observability gaps
gaps.observed: 21 of 25 active zones have Web Analytics/RUM coverage.
gaps.businessReason: Neglected properties can silently fail or miss opportunities when they are outside the same measurement fabric.
gaps.target: 25 of 25 active zones observed or explicitly exempted
gaps.nextAction: Enable or explicitly exempt browser analytics for the four uncovered zones and make the audit automatic.
gaps.evidence: Cloudflare zone inventory + Web Analytics site inventory.

gaps.title: Replace stale portfolio-era narrative
gaps.observed: README.md and STATUS.md still describe an obsolete portfolio product and old estimated performance claims.
gaps.businessReason: Contradictory product descriptions undermine diligence and cause agents to reason from the wrong product state.
gaps.target: Repository narrative matches the source-first intelligence product and cites verifiable evidence
gaps.nextAction: Replace stale README/STATUS content in GD-028 and add drift detection for investor-facing claims.
gaps.evidence: README.md and STATUS.md on main at GD-027 merge head.

gaps.title: Instrument meaningful business conversion events
gaps.observed: No certified investor-facing funnel for subscriber, partner, donor, sponsor, licensing, or investor-intent conversion is represented here.
gaps.businessReason: Traffic without conversion or retention evidence does not explain economic potential.
gaps.target: Named conversion and retention events with source, date window, and attribution limits
gaps.nextAction: Define the business-event taxonomy, connect first-party/GA4 event telemetry, and connect commerce/donation data where applicable.
gaps.evidence: No certified funnel is present in the current Mission Control snapshot.

gaps.title: Unify estate health and availability
gaps.observed: Traffic and content observability exist, but cross-property availability, latency, deploy freshness, and broken critical paths are not yet represented together.
gaps.businessReason: A broad estate needs autonomous detection of silent failure, not periodic human rediscovery.
gaps.target: Estate-wide status, latency, deploy freshness, broken-link and critical-path checks
gaps.nextAction: Ingest production health checks for every active property and rank failures by user and business impact.
gaps.evidence: Current Mission Control has coverage inventory but no per-property service-health table.

gaps.title: Quantify Culture Sherpa convergence opportunity
gaps.observed: Culture Sherpa is a separate high-potential property conceptually aligned with GlobalDeets' place-based context layer.
gaps.businessReason: The integration thesis may improve differentiation, retention, and content depth, but should be supported by usage and overlap evidence.
gaps.target: Evidence-backed integration thesis with shared audience, content, and product metrics
gaps.nextAction: Measure overlap, unique utility, cross-navigation, search demand, and migration/integration options before convergence decisions.
gaps.evidence: GlobalDeets 2030 product plan names Culture Sherpa as the culture layer.

gaps.title: Retire misleading legacy analytics dashboard
gaps.observed: analytics.html still visualizes old portfolio-project categories rather than current traffic, product, or business performance.
gaps.businessReason: An investor following an Analytics link should never land on decorative project-count charts that resemble business analytics.
gaps.target: Mission Control is the canonical analytics and diagnostics surface
gaps.nextAction: Replace analytics.html with a durable handoff to Mission Control and update navigation references.
